description: Scan links in a webpage or local file path using linkinator. Checks for broken links, validates anchors, and can crawl recursively. Supports progress notifications for long-running scans.

checkCss.description: Extract and validate URLs in CSS properties

path.description: URL or local file path to scan

port.description: Server port for local scanning (random port by default)

recurse.description: Follow links recursively on the same domain

retry.description: Retry HTTP 429 responses with retry-after header

retryErrorsJitter.description: Random delay between retries in milliseconds

serverRoot.description: Custom disk location where the server starts

timeout.description: Request timeout in milliseconds (0 = no timeout)

name: scan_page
